# Welcome to  
BSA Family Adventure Camp

Welcome to BSA Family Adventure Camp – a one-of-a-kind vacation for
adventurers of all ages! Gather up your whole crew – cousins, friends,
grandparents, groups – and experience the great outdoors as never before. (FYI
– it’s open to all families, not just Scouts.)

The best part? Where you stay and what you do are up to you! It’s your
adventure, your way. Choose to vacation at any one of our camps, which are
located in some of the USA’s most incredible destinations: West Virginia, New
Mexico, and Florida. From bunkhouse rooms to luxury deluxe tents, each
location offers lodging options that keep you connected to what matters most:
nature, and each other. Enjoy any of our epic activities, including swimming,
hiking, horseback riding, ziplining, and much more.

**Come for a week, or just a few days. Make memories that will last forever.**

Start a New Experience

Reserve Your Adventure

Discover Our Family Adventure Camp Locations

__

DESTINATIONS

The Summit  
Bechtel Reserve

Situated in the wilds of West Virginia, Summit Bechtel Reserve gives campers a
chance to experience all of the high adventure and glorious beauty of the New
River Gorge area.

[ __ view more ](https://www.summitbsa.org/familyadventurecampwv)

Philmont  
Scout Ranch

Located on the eastern edge of the Rocky Mountains, Philmont Scout Ranch
offers epic experiences in the heart of the American West. It’s an adventure
base for all ages!

[ __ view more ](https://www.philmontscoutranch.org/adventure-camp/)

Florida  
Sea Base

Nestled in Scout Key between the Gulf of Mexico and the Atlantic Ocean, Camp
Jackson Sawyer (a.k.a., Florida Sea Base) is a tropical adventure paradise.

[ __ view more ](https://www.bsaseabase.org/camping/)

CAMPING AND LODGING

We know that everyone’s version of “roughing it” is a little different. That’s
why we offer three types of lodging to choose from – rustic tents, cabins, and
luxury deluxe glamping tents – to give everyone in your family a camping
experience that they’ll love.

[Rustic  
Tents](https://scouting.org/outdoor-programs/family-adventure/rustic-tents/)

## About Family Adventure Camp

BSA Family Adventure Camp is a one-of-a-kind vacation that takes “family time”
to a whole new level. Camps are open to families, friends, and groups across
the country (not just Scouts). Each location has its own unique programs,
experiences, and landscapes. From lodging to activities, campers have the
freedom to choose where they want to stay and what they want to do. At Family
Adventure Camp, families will come together to make lasting memories as they
have once-in-a-lifetime experiences and enjoy the great outdoors together.
